items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: First George Colemen, Wayne Shorter, Ron Carter, Tony Williams.

ctx.x: Yeah, see, because they discovered him, and they made the hit Watermelon Man. He just – he started making movies, all kinds of different stuff. Of course he was with Miles Davis during Miles’s big years, when he had – what? – Shorter with him and Coleman, playing tenor.
Wayne Shorter. First George Colemen, Wayne Shorter, Ron Carter, Tony Williams.
The thing that really surprised me was when Sam Rivers was with him for a while.
